image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Triceratops from the config library at the victory ceremony. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Dusty ochre skin, thick leathery texture; massive head frill is a SOLID UNIFORM DEEP OCHRE. Symmetrical burnt orange tiger-stripe patterns on flanks. Three polished off-white horns. ACTION: He is positioned directly behind a wooden three-tier victory podium. He is so large that he towers over it; he has his heavy front feet resting on the lower tiers while his massive head is lifted high, positioned proudly over the center '1st Place' level. A bright red 'Winner' ribbon is draped over one of his brow horns. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A stoic, dignified smirk; his soulful brown eyes look out at the crowd with quiet pride. SETTING: The finish line ceremony area on the dirt track; LANCE_HELL_CREEK environment with lush ferns and palm-like Bennettitales. In the background, other dinosaurs are blurred and cheering. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC' with golden hour light catching the solid ochre of his frill. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' low-angle shot looking up at the dinosaur to emphasize his scale.
